news.title: Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot
news.summary_raw:
We’re reimagining Microsoft Copilot to enable work as it evolves and to help expand what every individual and every organization can accomplish in the flow of human ambition. Today we’re introducing the new Copilot to connect the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI...
The post Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog.
news.summary: Microsoft has launched a new version of Copilot that integrates Home, Code, and Autopilot capabilities across its ecosystem, enabling deeper AI-driven automation within Microsoft 365, Azure, and related services. This expansion promises enhanced workflow efficiency and smarter integration for users and IT administrators alike.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Go to the Microsoft 365 admin center this week and review the new Copilot settings under the AI & Automation section. S2: Failing to adopt these controls risks missing opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and could expose the organization to inconsistent policy enforcement across Office apps. S3: The most affected tool is Microsoft 365, but integration with Azure AD and Intune (MDM) will also be critical for seamless access and device management.

news.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
news.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, the latest iteration of its Gemini family, promising significant performance gains and expanded multimodal capabilities. This model is expected to power next‑generation AI features across Google Workspace and other enterprise tools.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Visit the Google Cloud AI Platform and review the new Gemini 4 Argon API documentation to determine compatibility with your existing Workspace add‑ons. S2: Deploying this model can reduce manual content generation and improve data insights, but early testing is needed to ensure latency and cost align with your SLA. S3: The most relevant tools are Google Workspace Admin Console and Google Cloud IAM, where you can enable preview access and set up role‑based permissions for the new API.

news.title: New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
news.summary_raw:
Every organization has knowledge that is uniquely its own: the way its business operates, the data it has built over time, the expertise of its people and the context behind thousands of everyday decisions. As powerful AI models become more widely available, that unique business intelligence matters more than ever. The difference will come from...
The post New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog.
news.summary: Microsoft unveiled new data‑centric AI innovations that enable organizations to extract deeper insights from their unique business data. These enhancements extend Azure’s AI and data services, providing tighter integration with existing Microsoft 365 and Power Platform workflows.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Review the new Azure AI and data services in the Microsoft 365 admin center this week and test the updated data connectors in Power Automate. S2: Failure to adopt could mean missing out on automated insights that competitors are already leveraging, potentially leaving your security and compliance gaps unaddressed. S3: Azure Cognitive Services and Power Platform are the most affected tools, offering immediate impact on your MDM, SSO, and endpoint monitoring pipelines.

news.title: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
news.summary_raw:
Extreme space-weather events can damage power systems on Earth and degrade GPS accuracy and satellite operations. A new machine learning system can predict where damage is likely to occur 30-60 minutes before a storm arrives.
The post Forecasting space weather risks on power grids appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has unveiled a machine learning system that forecasts space weather events with a 30-60 minute lead time, potentially preventing damage to power grids and mitigating GPS disruptions caused by solar storms.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Schedule a review of your Azure cloud infrastructure and related monitoring tools to assess how the new ML model could be integrated for predictive alerts on power‑grid dependencies. S2: Failure to consider this advance may leave your data centers vulnerable to unplanned outages triggered by geomagnetic disturbances, increasing downtime costs. S3: Azure and Microsoft 365 services will most directly benefit from early warnings, allowing proactive load balancing and resource allocation.

news.title: Automating coherent long-form video generation
news.summary_raw: Generative AI
news.summary: Google AI has launched a new generative model that automatically creates coherent long‑form video content from textual prompts. The system stitches together scenes, adds narration, and generates subtitles, aiming to streamline video production for marketers and content creators.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Review Google AI's video generation API documentation and evaluate integration possibilities with your existing Google Workspace tools such as Drive and Sites this week. S2: Failing to adopt could leave your team reliant on costly third‑party video editors, increasing time to market for internal training videos and marketing collateral. S3: The most impacted tool is Google Workspace, where embedding auto‑generated videos could enhance collaboration and reduce manual editing workload.

news.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
news.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar, a real‑time conversational AI model that can generate dynamic avatars and interactive dialogue. This release extends Gemini’s capabilities into live, visual interactions, paving the way for new user‑experience features across Google’s ecosystem.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Examine Google Cloud’s Gemini API documentation and prototype the Live Avatar SDK in a test environment this week. S2: Failing to evaluate this early could mean missing out on integrating immersive, AI‑driven interfaces into internal tools or customer portals, potentially lagging competitors. S3: The most directly impacted tool is Google Workspace via the Admin Console, where future updates may expose new AI‑powered collaboration features.

news.title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.
news.summary_raw: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.
news.summary: Photon, a startup, has secured $4.5M to develop AI agents that operate across messaging platforms like iMessage, SMS/RCS, and email, positioning agents as a replacement for traditional mobile apps.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Review Photon’s agent platform this week to evaluate if it can replace or augment your current mobile app workflows. S2: Failing to assess this technology could mean missing an opportunity to streamline user engagement and reduce maintenance overhead on your existing app portfolio. S3: This tool directly impacts your endpoint security and MDM strategy by potentially shifting user interactions away from app-based ecosystems to agent-based ones.

news.title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
news.summary_raw: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.
news.summary: OpenAI has partnered with America’s Small Business Development Center (SBDC) to provide AI training and local support for small businesses. The initiative includes a report on how small teams are adopting AI technologies.
news.enterprise_use: Keep an eye on the training resources and success stories released by this partnership, as they may uncover cost‑effective AI tools or workflows that can be adapted for internal IT operations. Monitor the report for insights on AI tool usage patterns that could inform future automation or support initiatives in your environment.

news.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
news.summary_raw: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.
news.summary: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-6.1 Sol, a cost‑effective AI model designed for coding and professional tasks, priced at one‑fifth of the standard Astra token rates.
news.enterprise_use: Review OpenAI’s new pricing structure and consider integrating GPT‑6.1 Sol into your internal toolchain for automated code reviews or documentation generation. This could reduce API spend and accelerate development cycles, but be mindful of potential model compatibility issues with existing workflows.

news.title: Introducing SynthID Bio
news.summary_raw: Proof of concept for watermarking AI-generated proteins while preserving biological function.
news.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled SynthID Bio, a proof‑of‑concept tool that watermarks AI‑generated proteins without compromising their biological function. The technology demonstrates how AI can embed traceable identifiers in synthetic biology outputs, potentially shaping future regulatory and compliance frameworks.
news.enterprise_use: Keep an eye on SynthID Bio as it could influence how your organization manages intellectual property and compliance for bio‑engineering projects. Evaluate its applicability for protecting proprietary protein designs or for ensuring traceability of AI‑generated biological assets.

news.title: Introducing Olmo-core 3: Open, scalable training infrastructure for large MoEs
news.summary: Hugging Face has launched Olmo-core 3, an open-source, scalable training infrastructure optimized for large Mixture-of-Experts models. The platform promises faster, more efficient training pipelines that can be integrated with existing ML workflows.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Explore integrating Olmo-core 3 with your current AI model training workflows to reduce training time and resource costs. S2: This can streamline model development cycles and allow your team to experiment with larger MoE architectures without additional cloud spend.

news.title: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular Sets a New Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
news.summary: NVIDIA has released the Kumo Tabular model, a high‑efficiency transformer that outperforms existing baselines on standard tabular datasets. The model promises faster inference with comparable or better accuracy, making it attractive for data‑centric workloads.
news.enterprise_use: Review NVIDIA's Kumo Tabular model within the next 30 days to determine if it can accelerate predictive analytics for incident triage or capacity planning. Integrating this model into existing data pipelines could reduce GPU utilization and improve response times for monitoring alerts.

news.title: Brian Chesky interview: AI agents need their own operating system
news.summary_raw: Brian Chesky on making Airbnb agent-friendly, the state of consumer AI, and why the world needs an AI-native operating system.
news.summary: Brian Chesky of Airbnb discusses the need for an AI-native operating system to support AI agents. The interview highlights emerging concepts that could shape future AI infrastructure and deployment models.
news.enterprise_use: Watch Airbnb’s roadmap for AI agent integration; consider how an AI-native OS might influence the design of your own SSO and MDM environments. Integrating such capabilities could streamline policy enforcement and improve agent security.

In a closed a press briefing earlier today, OpenAI co-founder and president Greg Brockman offered an unusually direct formulation of that message, ending the session with: “Welc
news.summary: OpenAI has just unveiled GPT-6 Astra, claiming it represents a step toward true AGI and promises highly autonomous systems that outperform humans in economically valuable tasks.
news.enterprise_use: Note that GPT-6 Astra is a model release; for now, simply monitor its performance and documentation to evaluate potential integration into AI‑powered workflow tools or support chatbots in the next 90 days. Keep an eye on any updates to API access or pricing that could affect cost‑effective deployment of generative AI in your IT operations.

news.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
news.summary_raw: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.
news.summary: OpenAI has taken action to halt a coordinated effort aimed at extracting the inner workings of its models through adversarial distillation. The company is implementing new safeguards to prevent attackers from reverse-engineering model reasoning, thereby tightening the security of its AI offerings.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Monitor your AI service integrations and review any API calls that may expose model behavior. S2: A lack of updated security measures could allow attackers to replicate or manipulate your internal AI services, increasing risk of intellectual property theft or compliance issues.

news.title: How to Outcompete Your Client’s AI

Thanks to generative AI, it can now do that work internally, saving the firm hundreds of thousands of dollars in spending and compressing lease work that once stalled for […]
news.summary: Alturas Capital Partners’ in‑house lawyers now use generative AI to draft leases, eliminating the need for external counsel and cutting costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars. The move shows how AI can replace labor‑intensive legal work, but it does not directly involve any of the engineer’s daily tools.
news.enterprise_use: Keep an eye on how generative AI tools (e.g., GPT‑4o, Claude 3.5, or custom models) are being applied to internal workflows. Even though this doesn’t affect Google Workspace or JumpCloud right now, understanding these use cases can inform future decisions around AI‑powered document automation or compliance monitoring in your environment.

news.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
news.summary_raw:
Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions.
The post Introducing Q
news.summary: Microsoft Research has announced Quine, an AI research system that builds a multimodal world model of biology to help scientists explore and prioritize hypotheses across biological scales. The system aims to accelerate discovery by integrating diverse biological data and providing experimental feedback loops.
news.enterprise_use: Check the project’s public documentation for potential APIs or data integration points, and monitor for future releases that might offer reusable components for internal data analytics pipelines.
